parent_kind: Query ORPO initialized from clean Qwen3.5-9B

training.algorithm: clipped GRPO plus anchored duplicate rejection
training.reference: original ORPO parent remains frozen across all phases
training.phase_handoff: policy and optimizer state carry forward; rollouts use the policy at the start of their phase
training.advantages: Population-standardized rewards over exactly the four selected responses; extras are audit-only. Duplicates receive rejection loss and KL only; selected all-repeat groups retain rejection signal; measurement-failure pools excluded.
training.objective: ML delta-best plus 0.1 absolute term, perf=-uncensored PostgreSQL runtime; censored timeout no improvement; invalid=-0.5; duplicate=-1 with rejection loss
observability: per-step and cumulative LoRA weight delta L2 and relative L2
fixed duplicate probes before and after each phase
training.kl_guard: Mean reference KL on the current update batch checked before and after each update; no checkpoint published on an overshoot. This is a sampled-token diagnostic, not an exact full-distribution KL.

notes: Train800 only; test200 excluded. Up to 10 uncensored distinct plans per task for independent BOLT full SFT.
32 diverse difficult queries, ML late-improvement Pareto criterion, all 12 prefixes, no random GRPO fallback.

resources.sequence: GPU0 ORPO then GRPO; each PostgreSQL instance has three CPU cores and two parallel query workers, matching source oracle policy
resources.availability: preflight: bounded sharing of existing A800, no other process stopped

sampling.stop: Always collect the first four; if none beats the frozen prefix best loss, sample one at a time until the first strict improvement or ten total
sampling.group_weighting: equal weight per task/context group; normalize and average only its four selected members
sampling.sibling_context: fixed identical prompt; later siblings do not see earlier results
sampling.training_members: Keep the original four. If only an extra candidate improves, replace a uniformly random original member with that improver; match ML v14 with random.Random(f"{group_id}:{training.seed}"). Preserve all candidates and original sample IDs in the audit.

duplicate_matching.scope: full frozen prefix plus earlier siblings
matches: all active values equal at the existing six-significant-digit prompt display precision
duplicate_matching.evaluation: never reevaluate either kind; retain sampled answer in audit and apply rejection objective if selected among the four training members

retrieval.weak_source_policy: Explicitly report low/undefined rank agreement and task differences; no claim of reliable transfer.

query_timeout_policy.censoring: A timeout at a bound above the incumbent cannot establish improvement; fixed negative reward, no fabricated loss.
